title: Product update comms cadence & audience matrix: lightweight customer summaries and internal briefings
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Our current post-launch communication model mixes long-form changelogs with engineering-level release notes that are hard for customers and some internal teams to consume. Goal: Define a lightweight, repeatable cadence and audience matrix that produces two outputs per launch: 1) a one-paragraph customer-facing summary (what changed, why it matters, rollout/impact), and 2) an internal briefing (impact by team, SLO considerations, rollback guidance). Scope: product/console/SDK/hosting changes for hosted, dedicated, and private modes. Deliverables: templates for customer summary and internal brief; signoff matrix and SLA/impact thresholds that trigger different cadence; a minimal automation checklist so PMs can draft summaries from PR/PRD metadata; localization notes and embargo handling. Trade-offs: we prioritize clarity and timeliness over exhaustive itemization. That means occasional omission of minor infra-only fixes from customer summaries, but all changes will be captured in the canonical engineering changelog linked from the summary.
acceptance_criteria: Customer one-paragraph template and internal briefing template available in Confluence
Two pilot launches use the template end-to-end with <48h customer summary turnaround
Automation checklist documented: PR labels, commit message tags, PRD field mapping
Localization gating identified and SLA for localized summaries set
Runbook for embargoes and emergency patch communications approved

decisions: Adopt two-tier outputs (customer paragraph + internal brief) instead of a single multi-section changelog to reduce cognitive load for customers.
Minor infra fixes will be omitted from customer summaries unless they affect SLOs or user-facing behavior; they will remain in the engineering changelog.
Signoff cadence: PM -> Eng lead -> Support -> Sales -> Legal (if security/data change). Signoff window target: 24 hours for non-legal items.
Automation approach: lightweight PR labeling and a small script to assemble summary bullets into the customer paragraph; postpone full integration with CI until after pilot.
